description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValueEntity class, which extends CustomerOptionValue and implements Serializable. It includes fields for order and code, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing a customer option value with additional fields for order and code, serializable for storage or transfer.
